mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, movement_id, response_payload, created_at FROM inventory_idempotency_record WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND idempotency_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_idempotency_record (id, household_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, movement_id, response_payload, created_at) VALUES (#{entity.id}, #{entity.householdId}, #{entity.idempotencyKey}, #{entity.requestHash}, #{entity.movementId}, #{entity.responsePayload, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{entity.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (household_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
